node.title: E22 cross-scale root-set recovery
node.statement: If two E22 staircase locators at possibly different quotient moduli are equal, then they have the same root set; applying fixed-scale recovery at each modulus recovers the corresponding tail and selected fibers at each scale. Thus any hidden multiplicity is exactly a cross-scale equality of recovered root-set data.
node.attack_surface: locator root-set uniqueness plus fixed-scale recovery
node.falsifier: equal staircase locators with different root sets, or a fixed-scale tail/fiber recovery failure
